| description = 
Spawns at the end of the canyon (4 on map) when [[an advisor]] is killed.

Hits in the 200s, can quad, and harm touches (about 450).

Note that despite being in wolf form, this is NOT flagged as an animal and as such is not susceptible to Animal-Only spells. Note that he will despawn about 30 min after being aggroed.  On 1/24/2020 he despawned before being aggroed, so the despawn detail may be incorrect.

His MR is high, so it is very difficult to slow him. 60 necro and 54 mage killed him, but it was a rough fight. Best to clear all mobs up to the castle entrance from where he spawns, then trigger him. At lvl 60, he resisted 4 snares, but my lifetap dot, splurt and pyro all stuck. Best to send pets/blast him from up on top ledge by castle entrance to buy time before be paths up. He hits as hard as a lvl 58+ mob so he is a super undercon! With Malo/malosini and Tash, it is possible to land a slow on him, but still very difficult. With a slow however, it is entirely possible for a torp shaman to solo him.
